title.description: The service as people know it, for error messages: "SoundCloud".

tokenUrl.description: The service's token endpoint. The exchange sends nothing anywhere else.

style.description: How the service takes a token request. form: a POST with a form body, client_id and client_secret in it, for codes and refresh tokens (RFC 6749). query: a GET with client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri and code in the query, for codes only (Mixcloud).

clientIdEnv.description: The environment variable holding Local Network's client id at the service.

clientSecretEnv.description: The environment variable holding that client's secret.

services.description: By the id a plugin's account names at the end of its token_exchange address.

description: The services Local Network's token exchange (/api/token-exchange/<id>) signs locallibrary plugins in to, adding the client secret only this server holds.
